# fabricext_item (Data Source)

Resolves a Microsoft Fabric item's canonical UUID (`id`) from its `(workspace_id, display_name, type)` tuple.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "fabricext_item" "analytics_warehouse" {
  workspace_id = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001"
  display_name = "sales_analytics_wh"
  type         = "Warehouse"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `display_name` (String) Display name of the Microsoft Fabric item.
- `type` (String) Microsoft Fabric item type. Valid values: `Warehouse`, `Lakehouse`, `SQLDatabase`, `SQLEndpoint`, `SemanticModel`.
- `workspace_id` (String) UUID of the Microsoft Fabric workspace containing the item.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Resolved UUID of the Microsoft Fabric item.
